thesis: The podcast discusses the Gen AI 100 list, which identifies top AI-first consumer applications by ranking websites and mobile apps based on monthly visits and active users. The speakers argue that while the industry is moving quickly, content generation and editing, as well as companionship apps, are emerging as key categories where consumers show high willingness to try and pay.
